**Migration done.** All app code now calls `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Updated 12 files, 3 calls each: `couponService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `supplier.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `returnService.js`, `cohort.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `teamService.js`, `shipment.js`.

Left `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` on `db.query`. It's marked "vendored, do not edit, replaced wholesale on upgrade."

Next: decide if the vendored adapter needs a wrapper shim, since `lib/db.js:12` still keeps `query` deprecated but working for it.
